description: Search federal contract awards (USAspending, $10M+) by recipient, ticker, awarding agency, keyword, date range or minimum amount. Returns total_matching and pages with offset (up to 50 per call), sorted by date or amount. For "who won the most" questions use award_totals instead, which counts every match.

keyword.description: Word in the award description or NAICS description

since.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); only rows on or after this date

until.description: ISO date; only rows on or before this date

name: search_awards
title: Federal contract awards
